text.marquee: RANK UP CITY · BUILDING 1 · THE NEON CAFÉ
text.tagline:
Serve the customers. Survive the rush.
Impress the cat.
text.taglineEs: Escucha, responde y sirve. Suma patitas <ico-paw></ico-paw> en cada turno.
text.help: Easy: LISTEN to the order, TAP the food to add it to your tray, then hit SERVE. If you're stuck, Enri's PURR BOOST gives you a hint. You've got this.
text.bossWin: YES! Rookie — you did it! The Neon Café is officially five stars. Rank up! The Office Tower is waiting for you... when you're ready.
text.gameOver: Hey — the breakfast rush gets EVERYBODY. Take a breath and run it back. Enri believes in you. Probably.

boss.name: TOTTI
boss.quote: I observe. I judge. Then I nap.

epic.name: ENRI
epic.quote: I don't chase success. I nap and it finds me.

common.name: NEON CUP
common.quote: Full of potential. Refill and retry!

s1.name: First shift
s1.intro: Rookie! Welcome to your first shift at the Neon Café. Customers order — you build the tray. And heads up: Totti checks every tray you serve. Good luck!

rounds.line: Hi! Can I get a flat white and an avocado toast, please?
rounds.retryLine: That's not my order! A flat white and an avocado toast, please.

rounds.line: Hello! One tea and two cookies, please.
rounds.twist: Oh wait — actually, make that an orange juice. No tea, sorry!
rounds.retryLine: Hmm, that's not it. Remember — an orange juice and two cookies!

rounds.line: Morning! I'm Mia, by the way. I'm from Brazil. Where are you from?
rounds.retryLine: No, no — WHERE are you from? Your country!

rounds.line: Hey! Are you the manager here?
rounds.retryLine: Hmm? I asked about YOUR job.
rounds.thanks: Barista! Nice to meet you, mate.

rounds.preIntro: Heads up, rookie — food critic at the door. Impress her and we're famous. And remember: Totti is watching.
rounds.line: One latte. Two bagels. And a blueberry muffin. To go — I'm in a hurry.
rounds.retryLine: Wrong. Again: one latte, two bagels, and one blueberry muffin. Quickly, please.

s2.name: Rush hour
s2.intro: Rush hour, rookie. Numbers, prices, times. Stay sharp.

rounds.line: Morning! THREE flat whites and TWO bagels. The whole office is downstairs.
rounds.retryLine: Count again, mate — three coffees, two bagels!

rounds.line: One flat white and one cookie... how much is it?
rounds.retryLine: Check the board — three plus two!
rounds.thanks: Here you go. Keep the change!

rounds.line: I will collect my order at half past two. What time is that?
rounds.retryLine: HALF. PAST. TWO. It is not difficult.
rounds.thanks: Exactly. Two thirty. Don't be late.

rounds.line: Quick quick! One tea, one juice, one muffin — my train is at ten to five!
rounds.retryLine: The train! Tea, juice, muffin!

s3.name: Lost & found
s3.tag: Have / has · there is / there are · places
s3.intro: Busy day. Things are lost, mixed up, and the delivery just arrived. Fix it all with your words.

rounds.line: Wait — this isn't my order! MINE has no sugar, and it's a LARGE tea.
rounds.retryLine: No sugar! Large! Tea!
options: The large tea with no sugar — here.
The small coffee with sugar — here.

rounds.line: Excuse me — does this café have wifi?
rounds.retryLine: Wifi? Internet? Yes or no?
rounds.thanks: Perfect, thanks! I have big files to send.
options: Yes, it does. The password is on the board.
Yes, it is. The password is on the board.
Yes, I do. The password is on the board.

rounds.line: Put TWO bagels and THREE muffins in the display case.
rounds.retryLine: Two bagels! Three muffins! The case, rookie!

rounds.line: Hi! Is there any orange juice today?
rounds.retryLine: Juice! Is there juice?

rounds.line: Where are the napkins, mate?
rounds.retryLine: Napkins! WHERE?
options: They're on the counter, next to the cookies.
It's on the counter, next to the cookies.
There are on the counter, next to the cookies.

s4.name: Quiz night
s4.intro: It's QUIZ NIGHT at the café! Vera is the quizmaster. Answer fast, serve faster.

rounds.line: First question! A customer says THANK YOU. What do you say?
rounds.retryLine: Thank you! And you say...?

rounds.line: Team question! Can I pay by card here?
rounds.retryLine: Card? Can I? Yes or no!

rounds.line: Winners' round! Two juices, one muffin and one cookie for the champions!
rounds.retryLine: Two juices! A muffin! A cookie!

rounds.line: Final question, for the WIN: how do you ask about the price?
rounds.retryLine: The PRICE. The money question.

sb.name: The inspection
sb.intro: Rookie... head office called. Vera is not just a critic — she is the CITY INSPECTOR. Everything you learned. One shift. Go.

rounds.line: Inspection, part one. Two flat whites, two bagels, and one muffin. All correct, please.
rounds.retryLine: Part one, AGAIN. Two flat whites. Two bagels. One muffin.

rounds.line: Part two. A flat white is three dollars. A muffin is two. I had two flat whites and one muffin. Total?
rounds.retryLine: Three, plus three, plus two. Again.

rounds.line: Part three. One tea and one cookie.
rounds.twist: Actually — make that TWO cookies. Are you listening?
rounds.retryLine: One tea. TWO cookies. As I SAID.

rounds.line: Final part. A customer arrives at nine a.m. What do you say?
rounds.retryLine: It is MORNING. The customer is THERE. Speak.
rounds.thanks: ...Inspection passed. The café stays open. Well done, barista.
options: Good morning! What can I get you?
Good evening! What can I get you?
Good morning! What do you get me?
